subject: How the cell's recycling hubs falter with age
script: From Agewell Brief: How the cell's recycling hubs falter with age. Lysosomes, the cell's recycling hubs, may play a role in age-related diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's. Lysosomes are cell recycling centers that break down harmful molecules. Problems with lysosome function are linked to common age-related conditions. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
